outputs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original painted tactical fantasy battle sprite sheet. Reference defines ONE Dawnseed Bolter, bark-bodied humanoid with two wooden arms and legs, root claw feet, green leaf hood and mantle, dark face with two green eyes, white flowers and orange buds on shoulder, branching back twigs, orange seed pods at belt. Holds ONE broad branchwood crossbow with vine string, leaf wraps, hanging orange pods and a pointed red/gold seed bolt. RIGHT hand on trigger stock LEFT hand supporting fore-end. Preserve natural wood anatomy and gear. Exactly SIXTEEN full-body articulated poses in FOUR columns FOUR rows, fixed elevated three-quarter camera facing screen-right, constant figure/crossbow size, generous blank margins containing all branches and weapon. Genuine transparent RGBA background no painted checkerboard, floor/scenery/grid/labels. Row1: idle bow lowered; idle breathe shoulders tilt leaves sway; walk right foot forward left behind; opposite contact LEFT foot forward RIGHT behind, truly swap leading leg. Row2: passing foot lifted beneath pelvis; melee wind-up RIGHT hand releases trigger and draws fist back LEFT supports bow against chest; melee RIGHT fist punches screen-right LEFT retains bow; defense bows head behind crossbow braced with both hands. Row3: aim loaded crossbow screen-right; fire vine string snaps forward seed bolt leaves muzzle short distance, no second loaded bolt; reload right hand seats new seed bolt on empty guide LEFT supports crossbow; hit recoil torso back both hands retain weapon. Row4: dying one knee buckles eyes dim bow lowers; kneeling head bows bow rests across knees; fall sideways hips knees bent branches/cloth and crossbow land beside; dead side-lying bark body with DARK CLOSED eyes, limp leaves and intact crossbow/seed pods beside, no active glow. Exactly two arms two legs one crossbow, consistent vine string and limb ownership. Actual joint articulation not rotated standing cutouts. Original art only no copyrighted franchise assets.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct ONLY row2 column3 punch and row3 column3 reload in this sixteen-pose Dawnseed Bolter sheet. Punch: RIGHT arm from shoulder on viewer LEFT crosses in front of chest to extend fist screen-right. LEFT hand from shoulder on viewer RIGHT holds crossbow close to belly, not a second punch. Exactly two hands with correct ownership. Reload: remove the already seated red/gold bolt at crossbow muzzle, keep just ONE seed bolt being inserted by right hand over empty guide. Preserve all other fourteen poses, equipment, scale, canvas, layout and colors.
